name: 28654 · Moravian Fls, NC
findings: ZIP 28654 (Moravian Fls) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (79%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28654 (Moravian Fls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
